title: Don't be late
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Takahashi is meeting up with Aoki.

They have planned to meet at a place that is $D$ meters away from Takahashi's house in $T$ minutes from now.

Takahashi will leave his house now and go straight to the place at a speed of $S$ meters per minute.

Will he arrive in time?

## Constraints

- $1 \leq D \leq 10000$
- $1 \leq T \leq 10000$
- $1 \leq S \leq 10000$
- All values in input are integers.

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
D T S
```

## Output

If Takahashi will reach the place in time, print `Yes`; otherwise, print `No`.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

Takahashi 要和 Aoki 碰面。

他们计划在 $T$ 分钟后，于距离 Takahashi 家 $D$ 米的地方见面。

Takahashi 现在就会从家出发，以每分钟 $S$ 米的速度直线前往该地点。

他能及时到达吗？

## 约束条件

- $1 \leq D \leq 10000$
- $1 \leq T \leq 10000$
- $1 \leq S \leq 10000$
- 输入中的所有值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
D T S
```

## 输出格式

如果 Takahashi 能及时到达该地点，输出 `Yes`；否则，输出 `No`。

samples.note: It takes $12.5$ minutes to go $1000$ meters to the place at a speed of $80$ meters per minute. They have planned to meet in $15$ minutes so he will arrive in time.
It takes $20$ minutes to go $2000$ meters to the place at a speed of $100$ meters per minute. They have planned to meet in $20$ minutes so he will arrive just on time.
